title: Missing unit in uses (unit-missing-from-uses)
summary: Lint rule: names the unit that declares an undeclared identifier and adds it to the interface or implementation uses clause, cycle-checked
intro: Read this when the IDE says Undeclared identifier for a name another unit declares (CodeSite without CodeSiteLogging in uses). The rule names the unit and the clause -- interface when the name is used there, else implementation -- checks the new uses edge for a circular unit reference first, and fixes it from Ctrl+Alt+U, the LSP light bulb or lint --fix --apply.
notes: VS Code on save: the LSP also offers the single-resolution fix as source.addMissingImports (see auto-uses-on-save); an ambiguous name stays quickfix-only
